summary:
Plan for w203 (spec-integration#r45) is in .shop/scratch/2-plan/plan.md.
The r45 scenario is red: none of its six steps is defined, and nothing tells the integrate round to draft lines an answer asks for beyond the request's accepted lines.
D1: answers reach the round by the existing path (the initiative's Questions and Answers, supervision r57). No reader of the request's ## Answers is added, so workqueue_request.py drops out of the researcher's file set.
D2: the integrate brief gains an r45 sentence, given only when the brief carries answers.
D3: the agent and skill integrate text name answers as an input and keep a line that quotes an answer (r2, r45). Both files are added to the set.
D4: the Then checks the brief's answer and r45 sentence, the drafts under round-*/notifications.md (r107) and the drafted notifications proposal (r92).
No existing test breaks (checked against the notes' §4). Open cases are listed; integrate-question defect 1 is left to the implementer to name.
